about_the_game:
🐾 Get ready for a much bigger adventure in this relaxing game full of adorable cats. Explore giant maps expanded 5x and search for 999 hidden cats and 444 extra cute objects scattered across unique landscapes throughout the country.
Hand-drawn scenes filled with colorful streets, historic buildings, and cultural landmarks are waiting for you.

🔎 As you search for cats and cute objects, animated elements bring the world to life.
🎨 After finding everything, unwind with a peaceful color-by-numbers experience.

🎮 Features
🐱 Find 999 hidden cats in each scene
🧸 Discover 444 cute side objects
🗺️ 5x larger, detail-rich hand-drawn maps
🌍 Lively scenes reflecting the spirit of the country
👯‍♂️ Play solo or with a friend
🎶 Clear your mind with Meow FM
